title: SKF_REFINE_ARCHITECTURE_RESULT_JSON envelope (v1)
description: Single-line JSON document skf-refine-architecture emits when {headless_mode} is true, prefixed with the literal 'SKF_REFINE_ARCHITECTURE_RESULT_JSON: ': once on stdout when step 6 (report) writes the result contract, after step 5's review promoted the refined document, and once on stderr at every HARD HALT (status error). The shared emitter, skf-emit-result-envelope.py, builds every line from the payload a stage stages in the run folder, folds in the auto-decisions and warnings the run recorded there, derives exit_code from halt_reason, stamps run_id and result_path, and checks the line against this schema, so the model never types it. The skill's references/exit-codes.md lists the exit codes and the stage files hold the halt command.

skf-envelope.description: The shared emitter's settings for this workflow, read by skf-emit-result-envelope.py: the workflow, the line's prefix, the wrapper, the status a halt carries, the exit code of each halt_reason and the result file stem. Nothing in the schema references this entry, so it constrains no envelope.

status.description: 'success' when the review approved the draft, the preservation check passed and the refined document was promoted to its output path. 'error' on any HARD HALT.

refined_path.description: The refined document, refined-architecture-<arch_project_name>.md in the output folder. Null on a halt before the review's [C] promoted the draft: a halt or a cancel before then leaves the output path as it was.

previous_refined_path.description: Where the earlier refined document went: the review's [C] renames a file already at the output path to refined-architecture-<arch_project_name>-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.md (the run's timestamp, with -2, -3 ... when that name is taken) before it promotes the draft, so it is never overwritten. Null when there was none, and on a halt before the promotion.

previous_pass.description: True when the architecture document held an earlier Refine Architecture pass (RA's marked blocks, the unmarked annotations of an older pass with their Refinement Summary, or a refined-architecture-*.md file): the run set those annotations aside, analyzed the rest and replaced them with one current set.

gap_count.description: Gap-fill subsections in the refined document, counted by the preservation script from the insertion plan it applied. 0 on a halt.

issue_count.description: Issue annotations in the refined document, counted from the insertion plan. 0 on a halt.

improvement_count.description: Improvement suggestions in the refined document, counted from the insertion plan. 0 on a halt.

unverified_count.description: Technologies the architecture document names that no skill covers, so nothing checked what it says about them (the Refinement Summary's Not verified (no skill) row), counted from the insertion plan. 0 on a halt.

exit_code.description: Process exit code matching the skill's references/exit-codes.md table, derived from halt_reason: null gives 0, input-missing and input-invalid 2, output-folder-unconfigured, forge-folder-unconfigured and resolution-failure 3, write-failed and preservation-failed 4, insufficient-skills 5, user-cancelled 6, inventory-unreliable 7, recovery-failed 8.

halt_reason.description: Null on success. One of the documented HALT classes on error, so a pipeline branches on the failure class without parsing the prose message. preservation-failed: the draft would not keep every line of the original architecture document, so it was not promoted.

run_id.description: The run's id, stamped by the emitter from the run folder name: the run's activation timestamp (YYYYMMDD-HHmmss, UTC). Null for a halt before the run folder exists.

result_path.description: The per-run result file the emitter wrote in the output folder, refine-architecture-result-<YYYYMMDD-HHmmss>.json (UTC), beside its refine-architecture-result-latest.json copy. Stamped by the emitter, never typed; step 6 passes it to the on_complete hook. Null on every halt, which writes no result file, and when the write failed (warnings say why).

gate.description: The gate that auto-resolved: init.vs-report (step 1 answered the [VS] report question with its default, the report the probe found or none), init.vs-report-unreadable (step 1 could not read the --vs-report-path it was given and probed for the report instead), gap-analysis.scope (step 2 kept the derived document scope), compile.review (step 5 approved the draft). The gate records its decision in the run sink the moment it decides.

default_action.description: The action documented as the gate's default, such as 'C' for [C] continue or 'use-found-report'.

taken_action.description: The action the run took. In a headless run it equals default_action.

reason.description: Human-readable rationale, the line the gate logged, such as 'headless: auto-approve compiled architecture'.

evidence.description: Optional gate-specific data, such as the report a headless run used or the in-scope and out-of-scope skills it kept.

headless_decisions.description: Optional. One entry per gate that auto-resolved during the run, read from the run sink, so a halt reports the decisions taken before it. Present only when there is at least one.

warnings.description: Optional. Non-fatal anomalies the run recorded in its sink or the emitter raised, one string each, starting with its code: vs_report_not_read when the feasibility-report helper is unavailable, malformed_ra_markers when the document holds an RA marker without its pair (left in place as ordinary text), legacy_blocks_set_aside when an older pass left unmarked RA blocks, which run to the next heading and were set aside unchecked (it names their lines, so a user paragraph inside one is not silently counted as preserved), unknown_scope_skills when --scope-skills names a skill that is not in the inventory, scope_fallback_all_skills when --scope-skills or the document names no inventory skill and every skill is analyzed, out_of_scope_skills when the run's scope left inventory skills out (it counts and names them, so a run scoped with --scope-skills still says what it did not check), customization_resolver_unavailable when the team and user overrides were not applied, and result_file_write_failed when the emitter could not write a result file. Present only when there is at least one.

phase.description: Where the run halted: the step and gate, for example 'init:vs-report' or 'compile:promote'.

reason.description: The halt message the step displayed, on one line.

path.description: Optional path the failed operation targeted.

error.description: Present on a HARD HALT only: where the run stopped and why. Pipelines branch on halt_reason and read error for the diagnostic.
